_meta.title: Odisea Adversarial QA / Red Team Defects Ledger

defects.title: Footnote tokens (fn:...) not expanded in export_html_snippet
defects.description: In heavy documents with 500+ footnotes, transform_inline did not match (fn:...) or (fn), emitting raw parenthesized text instead of <sup>[...]</sup> tags.
defects.fix_commit: Added inline scanner for (fn:...) and (fn) in transform_inline emitting <sup>[note]</sup>.

defects.title: Single quotes in font-family string literals rejected by ULSS lexer
defects.description: ULSS lexer only accepted double quotes '"', throwing 'Unexpected character in ULSS: '\'' when styles declared font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable'.
defects.fix_commit: Allowed both '"' and '\'' quote delimiters in UlssLexer tokenization.

defects.title: Variable definition with colon ($var: val) threw Expected '='
defects.description: ULSS parser strictly demanded '=' for variable assignments, breaking styles using CSS-flavored colon assignment syntax.
defects.fix_commit: Updated parse_variable_definition to accept both Token::Equals and Token::Colon.

defects.title: Mixin declaration with @mixin prefix threw Expected '{'
defects.description: ULSS parser expected @name { ... } directly and failed when authors declared @mixin name { ... }.
defects.fix_commit: Added lookahead check in parse_mixin_definition to extract identifier if token name is 'mixin'.
